The bare go-out participle yotze is written defectively throughout the Torah except three full spellings (Exod 8:16, 8:25, 11:4)
ve-etz ('and the tree' of knowledge) carries the zaqef gadol accent
le-avdah ('to work it') ends in he with mappiq (consonantal 3fs suffix)
u-le-shamrah ('and to keep it') ends in he with mappiq (consonantal 3fs suffix)
